title: Contract-First Epistemology: Measurement, Return, and the Structure of Legitimate Claims (Full Course Architecture v1.0)
source_native_claims: A twenty-eight-week college-level teaching architecture within the GCD / UMCP teaching route whose formal field anchor is Contract-First Epistemology of Measurement (record description).
